entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is important to us. Please wait while we connect you with the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex, how can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I recently received a bike from VeloFit and unfortunately, it arrived damaged. I'm pretty upset.
I'm so sorry to hear that! Could you describe the damage for me?
Well, the most obvious thing is the bike frame. It has a cracked frame near the handlebars. Also, one of the wheels is terribly wobbly wheel, like it's not properly aligned.

Oh no, that sounds awful! We sincerely apologize that your VeloFit bike arrived with a cracked frame and wobbly wheel. That is definitely not the VeloFit experience we want you to have. It sounds like this was caused by shipping damage. To rectify this immediately, we'd like to offer you a full refund for the bike. Would that be acceptable?
Really? A full refund? That would be great!

Absolutely! We'll process that refund immediately. We'll also send you a free label so you can ship the bike back to us at no cost to you. You won't need to pay for return shipping, we'll take care of it all with a free label.
Wow, that's fantastic! I really appreciate that. Where will the free label be sent?

The free label will be emailed to the address we have on file for your VeloFit account. You should receive it within the next hour. Once you receive the label, just repack the bike as best you can in the original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
Okay, sounds good. That's really a relief. Thank you for making this so easy.
You're very welcome! We value your business, and we're truly sorry for the inconvenience caused by the shipping damage. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's all. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
